head: """Dispatcher del core: ejecuta la capacidad elegida y maneja errores TÉCNICOS.

def __init__(

self.execution = execution or ToolExecutionFacade(registry)

self,
cmd: Command,
intent: Intent | None,
origin: ExecutionOrigin = ExecutionOrigin.UNSPECIFIED,
) -> ToolResult:
if intent is None:

result = self.execution.execute(cmd, intent, origin=origin)

if self.execution.v2_enabled:
data.setdefault("routed_by", "tool_ecosystem_v2")
else:
data.setdefault("routed_by", intent.source)
data.setdefault("route_score", round(intent.score, 3))
